taskSummary: Implemented searchable combobox for faculty committee appointments, enforced institutional 'Faculty' role nomenclature for non-instructor academic staff, standardized 3 defense panelists (Panelist 1, Panelist 2, Panel Member 3 without optional label), and enforced mutual exclusion preventing adviser or secretary from serving as panelist or duplicating roles on the same team.
keyLessons: Default array parameters in React components (e.g. initialPanelistIds = []) create a new array reference on every render, causing useEffect dependencies to falsely trigger and reset form state. Stabilize with Object.freeze([]) and serialized dependency strings.

Institutional BukSU role presentation: course instructors are designated [Instructor], while all other faculty appointees (advisers, panelists, secretaries, chairs) must display under the unified [Faculty] title.
Defense Panel Committee Structure: strictly 3 defense panelists (Panelist 1 Lead/Chair, Panelist 2 Member, Panel Member 3), none labeled optional.

Role Conflict Prevention & Mutual Exclusion: in both client and backend service layers, an adviser cannot be a secretary or panelist on the same team, a secretary cannot be a panelist, and defense panelists must be distinct faculty members.
